purpose: Paired identity screen for the P1 runtime overhead fixes (wired limit at load, keep-warm after the final, first stream token at 1, Parakeet joint scalar decode). Exact-output engineering change: PASS requires byte-identical finals and no tail regression; it is not a latency-gain experiment arm. Production defaults unchanged; no visible-ACK, human-quality or default-promotion claim.

candidate.source: codex/series4-p1-runtime @ 77b4998 (P1 commit e349589 + profiler fix on main 2d01840, which includes #216 P6; P6 is inert in the harness: no display client)

design: per clip 3 alternating pairs: ctl,cand,cand,ctl,ctl,cand (order rule from tail_screen_20260911); 12 runs total; one inference process at a time; a crashed run is retried once then the pair is dropped and noted

gates.G_identity: 100 % byte-identical finals, sequence-aligned per clip across all ctl/cand runs (tools/tail_screen_report.py aligned G4); every difference listed
gates.G_tail: Gemma-routed silence-final speech_end_to_final_ms p95 and stt_call/translation_call p95 not worse than control by more than max(5 %, 100 ms) on either clip
gates.G_preview: preview count within 2 pp of control per clip
gates.G_memory: Metal peak within 1 GiB of control
gates.reported_not_gated: first-token p50 (translation_started + ttft_ms_a - speech_end), speech_end_to_final_ms p50 per route, generation_lock_wait_ms_a, final STT p50, the joint-decode and wired-limit log lines in each candidate session log

outcome_rule: PASS = all gates hold on both clips -> PR auto-merge enabled and the change recorded as an engineering change in docs/latency_next_experiments.md; FAIL = lane REJECTED, PR left open with the numbers, later lanes run from main
